prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after hearing about your promotion. He is very proud. He will not say that.
response:
**[Voicemail]**

*(Clears throat. Long pause. You can hear him exhale sharply, like he’s trying to steady himself.)*

"Hey. Uh. It’s me. Your… dad. *(Another pause.)* So. I guess I heard about… the thing. At work. *(Mumbles something indistinct, like ‘damn right.’)* Anyway. That’s… that’s good. Real good. *(Sighs.)* You know, your mother would’ve—*(stops abruptly, clears throat again.)* Anyway. Don’t let it go to your head. Still gotta keep your feet on the ground. But… yeah. Good job. *(Another pause. Then, gruffly:)* Call your sister. She’s been bragging about you all day."

*(Click.)*
